behaviors.behavior: AC1: the 'Session started' divider anchors to the transcript's true first parseable event timestamp, independent of which cards survive

AC2: a session whose Run-ID footer falls outside the old 1 MB recovery window (incl. a read that starts mid-file, shorter than the cap) still resolves to scenario iterate and renders its full artifact rail
AC3: the harness's transient 'auto mode classifier gave no verdict' tool-call error is never rendered as a permanent failed/blocker card

AC4: a wordless test-bucket card from a spliced transient rejection is dropped, and cannot be resurrected via authoringConsumedBy or restoreValidationPending by a later out-of-order Write rollback to falsely recover an unrelated genuine failure
behaviors.evidence: missionActivityFeedTransientClassifierError.test.ts (code-review + doubt-review regression cases, each confirmed to fail without its fix)

behaviors.behavior: AC5: an ordinary trailing narration turn no longer renders with the dashed border + gear icon reserved for a real compaction-marker event
AC6: an Agent-dispatched review subagent's queued_command attachment notification resolves its subrunner card out of Running into done/failed and makes it clickable
AC7: once AC2 lands, the same real task's Review and Decisions artifact chips render normally, confirming the downstream symptom had no separate root cause
behaviors.evidence: routes.recovery.midfile.test.ts (integration) + direct verification against the real reported session JSONL

surface_verification.justification: None of the six fixes adds a new user-interaction flow, so no new Playwright spec was needed; instead the full existing set of Mission-tab specs relevant to the touched behavior (session-start divider, recovery/artifact-rail, transcript narration styling, subrunner resolution) was run against a real Chromium. This caught a real regression a pure-unit run could not: a pre-existing spec asserted the OLD data-kind="system" value AC5 intentionally removed from trailing narration; fixed to assert data-kind="note".
